sub_strands.name: Whole Numbers up to 1,000,000
performance_indicators: Read, write, and determine the place value of digits in whole numbers up to 1,000,000.
Round off whole numbers to the nearest tens of thousands.
Perform operations on whole numbers involving multi-step problem solving up to 1,000,000.

sub_strands.name: Fractions, Decimals, and Percentages
performance_indicators: Multiply and divide mixed fractions by whole numbers and simple fractions.
Convert recurring decimals into simple fractions using basic mathematical properties.
Calculate percentage increase and decrease in real-world commercial scenarios.

sub_strands.name: Surface Area, Volume, and Speed
performance_indicators: Calculate the surface area of basic 3D structures including cubes and cuboids.
Work out the volume of cylinders using practical models and standard formula frameworks.
Solve everyday life problems involving speed, distance, and time relationships.

sub_strands.name: Angles on Straight Lines and Simultaneous Expressions
performance_indicators: Investigate and apply the property that angles on a straight line add up to 180 degrees.
Construct parallel and perpendicular lines using a ruler and pair of compasses precisely.
Formulate and solve two-step linear equations containing a single unknown variable.

sub_strands.name: Debates and Critical Oral Evaluation
performance_indicators: Listen to structured arguments during a debate and outline valid points versus fallacies.
Express logical arguments confidently during classroom discussions using diverse conjunctions.

sub_strands.name: Advanced Literacy and Informational Texts
performance_indicators: Read abstract informational texts and technical charts fluently with correct intonation.
Identify explicit and underlying themes, biases, and author perspectives inside media articles.
Summarize multi-page narratives into brief, coherent core summaries independently.

sub_strands.name: Functional Writing and Creative Compositions
performance_indicators: Apply direct and indirect speech transformations accurately across written tasks.
Write comprehensive functional materials including formal letters, minutes of a meeting, and brief reports.
Compose imaginative narratives displaying rich vocabulary and cohesive paragraph transitions.

sub_strands.name: Uchambuzi wa Mijadala na Hotuba
performance_indicators: Kusikiliza maelezo na hotuba tata na kubainisha itikadi na hoja kuu za mzungumzaji.
Kutoa ripoti rasmi ya mdomo kuhusu miradi ya shule kwa kutumia lugha sanifu na fasaha.

sub_strands.name: Uandishi wa Kina na Fasihi ya Kiswahili
performance_indicators: Kusoma vitabu, majarida na makala ya magazeti kwa kasi, ufasaha na uelewa mkubwa.
Kutathmini maadili na mbinu za kifasihi zilizotumiwa katika riwaya fupi au tamthilia za darasani.

sub_strands.name: Insha za Kiubunifu na Matumizi ya Sarufi
performance_indicators: Kuandika insha za mjadala na barua rasmi za kiofisi kwa kufuata kanuni zote za kimuundo.
Kutumia mnyambuliko wa vitenzi na ngeli zote za Kiswahili kwa usahihi katika maandishi.

sub_strands.name: Human Circulatory System and Invertebrates
performance_indicators: Identify the major components of the human circulatory system (heart, blood, blood vessels) and outline their roles.
Classify invertebrates (insects, arachnids, mollusks, worms) based on observable physical traits.
Describe preventive measures and healthy habits that support the human circulatory network.

sub_strands.name: Light Refraction and Simple Machines
performance_indicators: Investigate the bending of light (refraction) through water prisms and glass lenses.
Identify, construct, and explain the mechanical advantages of simple levers and inclined planes.

sub_strands.name: Spreadsheets and Coding Logic
performance_indicators: Enter data and apply basic summation formulas within a spreadsheet application on a digital device.
Demonstrate basic block-based coding concepts and step-by-step algorithmic thinking exercises.

sub_strands.name: Drip Irrigation and Indigenous Crops
performance_indicators: Design and install basic drip irrigation loops using locally available recycled containers.
Determine optimal maturity signs for harvesting domestic root tubers and pulses.
Practice sorting and grading harvested produce to reduce post-harvest damages.

sub_strands.name: Bee Keeping and Honey Harvesting
performance_indicators: Identify the types of beehives and list safety gears required during apiary management.
Describe the economic importance and safe handling procedures for bees in agricultural setups.

sub_strands.name: Food Preservation and Safety Standards
performance_indicators: Demonstrate food preservation techniques including smoking, sun-drying, and basic canning.
Identify indicators of food contamination and practice hygienic food storage routines.

sub_strands.name: Position, Size, and Physical Features of East Africa
performance_indicators: Locate the East African region on a map of Africa and define its coordinate extensions.
Examine the major climatic regions of East Africa and their influence on economic human survival.
Interpret complex weather maps using advanced legends, contours, and physical scale indicators.

sub_strands.name: Historical Interactions and Regional Heritage
performance_indicators: Analyze the historical origins, interactions, and trade links of East African populations.
Examine regional cultural integration frameworks that support peace across border zones.
Identify key historical landmarks and regional treaties that shaped East African nations.

sub_strands.name: Regional Trade and Inter-State Administrations
performance_indicators: Evaluate the role of regional economic blocs (like the East African Community - EAC) in fostering cross-border trade.
Contrast the administrative structures and constitutional governance systems of East African states.

sub_strands.name: Still Life Painting and Fabric Design
performance_indicators: Paint still life compositions displaying accurate shadow distribution and proportional scaling.
Create patterns on textiles using tie-and-dye or batik design variations.
Carve functional artifacts or items using local soft wood, soapstone, or composite wax blocks.

sub_strands.name: Instrumental Orchestration and Scripting
performance_indicators: Play traditional Kenyan string or wind instruments in harmony with choral vocals.
Write and perform multi-character dramatic acts focusing on national values and inclusion parameters.

sub_strands.name: Athletics Field Events and Gymnastic Flows
performance_indicators: Demonstrate technical mechanics for high jump, long jump, and basic short-put release postures.
Execute coordinated artistic gymnastic routines involving cartwheels and structural human pyramids safely.

sub_strands.name: Biblical Covenants and Ethical Relationships
performance_indicators: Examine the significance of the Sinai Covenant and apply the Decalogue (Ten Commandments) to everyday choices.
Deduce moral guidance lessons from the New Testament parables regarding justice and civic responsibility.
Demonstrate transparency, integrity, and non-discriminatory behaviors across institutional team setups.

sub_strands.name: Surahs, Hadith, and Islamic Civic Architecture
performance_indicators: Recite, memorize, and explain the core rulings embedded in Surah Al-Ma'un and Surah Al-Kafirun.
Analyze the social welfare lessons from the Prophet's Hadith regarding zakat (almsgiving) and helping the poor.
Practice uniform courtesy, fair speech, and mutual respect when interacting with individuals of varied backgrounds.

sub_strands.name: Civic Responsibility and Integrity
performance_indicators: Demonstrate clear ethical accountability and proactive leadership when resolving group tasks.
Apply non-violent strategies to minimize peer tensions and maintain structural order.
Internalize moral benchmarks through consistent institutional mentor-guided group discussions.
